text:
anita: Heads-up: firewall rollout tonight 22:00 UTC will flip infra egress to deny-by-default for 10.200.0.0/16. Concern: GPU nodes in usw2 may lose egress to KMS and fail volume decrypt on boot. Can we gate the rollout until KMS is allowed?

ryan: Which CL/PR is that?

security-oncall: PR #6190. It tightens egress to operator CIDRs only. No KMS VPC endpoints or NAT EIP in allowlist.

kevin: Reminder: warm-pool and autoscale nodes call regional KMS through our NAT GW to unwrap EBS keys. If blocked, cloud-init will loop on decrypt and node never joins. We reproduced in staging.

sre-ops-bot: ALERT: 2025-06-12T21:10:12Z 1 observed gpu decrypt failures during dry-run in staging. Sample log: "cloud-init: ERROR: AccessDeniedException: User not authorized to use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01"

emma: Avoid IP allowlists for AWS-managed endpoints. Quick options: (A) add KMS VPC endpoint IDs (vpce-0abc1234) to allowlist, (B) exempt warm-pool subnets from deny, or (C) whitelist NAT GW EIPs as fallback. Long-term: enable FQDN egress via proxy.

ryan: Firewall appliance is CIDR-only, right? No FQDN rules?

security-oncall: Correct. FQDN via proxy is not ready for tonight. Fastest safe fix: hotfix PR that adds vpce IDs + NAT EIP fallback, plus smoke test.

anita: I'll pause the rollout and open hotfix PR to #6190 adding vpce-0abc1234 and NAT EIP 3.121.45.90. Also adding a quick smoke test to the runbook: curl KMS endpoint from warm-pool subnet and run aws kms decrypt.

kevin: Add CI sandbox gate that boots a minimal gpu node and verifies KMS unwrap + node join within 5m.

emma: I'll draft runbook PR and monitoring rule: gpu.node.decrypt.failures > 0 for 5m -> page oncall and trigger infra-rollout halt.

security-oncall: Holding tonight's rollout. Do not merge PR #6190 until one of: vpce allowlist, NAT EIP whitelisted, or confirmed proxy FQDN rule.

ryan: Ack. Release window marked held. Rollback window 22:15 UTC if things fail.

anita: Hotfix PR #6195 opened and tagged. Will update when smoke tests pass.

sre-ops-bot: Follow-ups created: runbook PR #6201, hotfix PR #6195, monitor PR #6202.
